activities.description: Cindy introduces the event, 'On the Same Page: Your City & You'.
She outlines the purpose of the event, which is to meet individuals from city government, organizations, and nonprofits.
She explains the event structure: three-night series, seven to eight speakers each night, five minutes per speaker, followed by a social hour with refreshments.
She thanks the sponsors, New Castle Community Partnership and New Castle Public Library.
She thanks Library Director Julie Kirk for hosting.
She introduces the first speaker, Mayor Mike Quaranta.

activities.description: Mike introduces himself as the Mayor of New Castle.
He provides an overview of the city: population, daytime population increase due to workers, number of neighborhoods, housing types, schools, and notable businesses.
He highlights the importance of commercial activity for subsidizing residential utility rates.
He outlines his various duties as Mayor: attending council meetings, serving on boards and commissions, making appointments, performing marriage ceremonies, and representing the city at events.

youtube_description:
Recorded 3/1/2023 at 'On the Same Page: Your City & You,' presented by New Castle Community Partnership and New Castle Public Library.

This video includes an introduction to the three-part series from event organizer Cindy Snyder, a member of NCCP and director of the New Castle Court House Museum.
